items.title: China is advocate, promoter, forerunner in Asia-Pacific economic cooperation: Xi
items.description: [Photo/Xinhua] SHENZHEN -- President Xi Jinping on Thursday said China is an advocate, promoter and forerunner in Asia-Pacific economic cooperation, and it is ready to work with all parties to build the pillars that support an Asia-Pacific community.
